_doc: Pinned URLs for the sources that are files or pages rather than an API. Every one was fetched live and recorded in docs/PROBE_FI.md. When a URL moves, fix it here — nothing else in the repository hard-codes it.

verohallinto_kiinteistovero.label: Verohallinto — kiinteistöveroprosentit kunnittain
verohallinto_kiinteistovero.licence: Licence not stated by publisher — public official figures. Attribution 'Lähde: Verohallinto'. Verohallinto's CC BY 4.0 statement (https://vero.fi/tietoa-verohallinnosta/tilastot/avoin_dat/, read 2026-09-24) is scoped to the corporate-tax datasets that page lists and does not name the tax-rate figures; neither the statistics index nor this PxWeb table carries a licence statement.
verohallinto_kiinteistovero.note: The 2026 column is marked ennakkotieto (preliminary) by the publisher.

verohallinto_tulovero.label: Verohallinto — kuntien ja seurakuntien tuloveroprosentit
verohallinto_tulovero.route: decision page, table embedded as JSON in a :rows= attribute
verohallinto_tulovero.licence: Licence not stated by publisher — public official figures. Attribution 'Lähde: Verohallinto'. The rate is published as a municipal-council decision; the page carries no licence statement.
verohallinto_tulovero.note: The rate is published as a decision, not as a statistic: no PxWeb table anywhere carries the municipal income tax percentage. The page's table is read from the JSON its own front end uses. Rows are matched to kunnat by name against kuntajako 2026 and every unmatched name is reported.
